# Project Conventions

<!-- Auto-generated by /ss:init — auto-detected sections are regenerated each run -->

## Code Style

- **Indentation:** tabs (`.prettierrc` `useTabs: true`)
- **Quotes:** single quotes (`singleQuote: true`)
- **Trailing commas:** none (`trailingComma: "none"`)
- **Line width:** 100 (`printWidth: 100`)
- **Prettier plugins:** `prettier-plugin-svelte`, `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` (Tailwind class sorting); `*.svelte` parsed with the svelte parser
- **Linting:** ESLint flat config (`eslint.config.js`) — `js.recommended` + `typescript-eslint` recommended + `eslint-plugin-svelte` recommended + `eslint-config-prettier`. `.gitignore` is honored via `includeIgnoreFile`. `no-undef` is off (TS handles it).
- **TypeScript:** `strict: true`, plus `allowJs` + `checkJs` (JS files are type-checked too), `moduleResolution: "bundler"`, `esModuleInterop`, `forceConsistentCasingInFileNames`. Extends `./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json`.
- Run `bun run format` (prettier --write) and `bun run lint` (prettier --check + eslint).

## Naming Conventions

- **Routes:** SvelteKit file conventions — `+page.svelte`, `+layout.svelte`, `+layout.ts` under `src/routes/`. No `+*.server.*` files (SPA only).
- **Components:** PascalCase `.svelte` files (e.g. `Welcome.svelte`).
- **Library code:** `src/lib/` (re-exported via `src/lib/index.ts`, the `$lib` alias). Styles in `src/lib/styles/*.css`. Server-only code belongs in `src/lib/server/**` (excluded from the client test project).
- **Tests:** colocated `*.spec.ts`; component tests `*.svelte.spec.ts` (e.g. `Welcome.svelte.spec.ts`).

## Project Patterns

- **Imports:** ES modules; `$lib` alias for library code; `.css` imported directly. Node built-ins via `node:` prefix (e.g. `node:path`).
- **Exports:** named exports preferred (barrel `src/lib/index.ts`).
- **Reactivity:** Svelte 5 runes only (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$props`) — runes forced project-wide in `svelte.config.js`.
- **Data access:** client-side via the shared supabase-js client (`src/lib/supabaseClient.ts`); no server load functions.
- **Styling:** design-tokens-first — `var(--token)` semantic aliases and `.nk-*` classes from `src/lib/styles/` before any raw value. Tailwind v4 utility classes auto-sorted by prettier.

## Testing Conventions

- **Runner:** vitest, two projects — _client_ runs `*.svelte.{test,spec}.{js,ts}` in a real chromium browser (`@vitest/browser-playwright` + `vitest-browser-svelte`); _server_ runs the rest in node.
- **Assertions:** `expect.requireAssertions` is on — every test must make at least one assertion.
- **E2E:** Playwright (`bun run test:e2e` → `playwright install && playwright test`).
- **Aggregate:** `bun run test` runs unit (`--run`) then e2e.

## Git Conventions

- **Commit messages:** Conventional Commits — `type(scope): subject`. Observed types: `feat`, `chore`, `docs`, `style`, `build`. Scopes used: `config`, `docs`, `design`. Lowercase, imperative subject.
- **Branching:** work off `main` (current default branch).
